intro: The Note chalkboard label makes organising simple and satisfying. Reusable, durable, and stylish, these labels bring order to your home while letting you customise your space the way you like.

features.title: Labels that grow with you
features.text: Write, wipe, and reuse—whether you’re reorganising your pantry or updating office files, these labels adapt to your changing needs.

features.title: Durable enough for everyday life
features.text: Crafted from high-quality, tear-resistant material, these labels stay intact, ensuring your storage remains neat day after day.

features.title: Perfect for every corner of your home
features.text: From kitchen jars to office files, these versatile labels make it easy to organise your space while adding a creative, personal touch.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
